verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is homepage marketing. It says Mixpanel's agents 'monitor your product continuously' and 'surface insights before you think to ask', and it shows an example insight ('Signups dipped 19% last week'). That loosely implies proactive alerting on metric changes, but no docs describe how it works. Missing for 10: documented dashboard subscriptions (scheduled email/digest delivery), documented anomaly-detection alert configuration (thresholds, notification channels), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
